description: A front-facing parcel has a rounded square outline and a wide sealing strip descending from the top edge. The strip ends in a V-shaped notch, and a short label mark sits near the lower right.
A side-view cargo ship has a long angular hull above a wavy waterline. A tall rectangular cargo block rises on the left, while a smaller cabin with a short mast stands at the right.
A square outer frame surrounds a recessed rectangular panel divided into three horizontal sections. The straight horizontal divisions read as shutter slats across the face of the container.
A rounded square parcel has a jagged crack descending from its upper edge. Two short vertical edges at the top lead into the zigzag fracture, leaving the lower face blank.
An upright wine glass has a rounded bowl on a slender stem and a flat foot. A piece is missing from the upper-left rim, with the detached chip floating beside the broken edge.
A closed box is seen from above at an angle, showing its top and two side faces. A tape band crosses the lid, and a jagged tear interrupts the front corner below it.
A closed box has a broad rectangular front beneath a shallow trapezoidal top. Two sloping seams bound a narrow central tape strip across the lid, while the front remains blank.
A closed box has a broad rectangular front beneath a shallow trapezoidal top. Two sloping seams bound a narrow central tape strip across the lid, while the front remains blank.
Three parcels form a compact pyramid, with one centered on top of two adjacent boxes. Each rounded box has a short sealing strip descending from its upper edge and ending in a V-shaped notch.

A low two-wheeled cart carries a large sealed parcel with a smaller box stacked above it. The platform curves upward at the right into a tall pushing handle, while the large parcel has a notched tape strip.

A platform cart carries two adjacent parcels and a smaller box centered above them. A tall handle rises on the left, two wheels sit below the platform, and short label marks identify the lower packages.

A side-view pallet jack has a long low fork extending right from a raised front housing. A slender upright handle ends in a triangular grip, with one large wheel at the housing and a smaller wheel beneath the fork.
A taped cube-shaped box sits in front of the lower-left side of an upright hand-truck frame. Two horizontal crossbars join its vertical rails, and the right rail curves inward at the bottom.

A domed warehouse with a rectangular doorway sits above two parcel boxes. A central vertical line beneath the doorway meets a horizontal branch connecting the two packages, each marked with a short tape tab.
Three taped boxes form a pyramid on a pallet, with one centered above two lower boxes. The pallet has long horizontal top and bottom edges connected by short upright supports beneath the load.
A side-view forklift faces left, with a tall vertical lifting mast and a short ground-level fork ahead of its body. Two wheels support a rounded chassis beneath a tall curved overhead frame.
A front-facing warehouse has a peaked roof and straight outer walls. A large rectangular loading doorway opens through the lower center, leaving two broad wall piers on either side.
